data.calendar_entities: Calendars to use for arming schedules
data.occupancy_default_day: Default arming state when occupied during day
data.occupancy_default_night: Default arming state when occupied at night
data.no_event_mode: Arming state when a calendar event ends

data_description.calendar_occupancy_override_states: When a calendar event sets one of these states, occupancy changes (arrivals and departures) can still update the alarm state. For example, if the calendar says Disarmed but everyone leaves, it will switch to Armed Away.

data_description.notify_enabled: Enable notifications for alarm state changes
data_description.notify_action: Home Assistant action (service) to use to notify
data_description.notify_targets: List of addresses or notify entities to notify, can be left blank for Supernotify

data_description.sentence_arm: English sentences for Home Assistant's built-in Assist agent, such as 'arm the alarm', 'arm the alarm in night mode' and 'why is the alarm armed'.
data_description.sentence_disarm: Adds 'disarm the alarm'. Warning: no code is asked for, so anyone who can talk to Assist, on a voice satellite or in the chat, can disarm the alarm.

data_description.use_alarm_service: Call the alarm_control_panel arm and disarm actions instead of setting the state directly. Needed for panels such as Alarmo that do their own processing, like arming child areas. The panel must not require a code.

Remove these from your YAML configuration and use the UI to manage them. Advanced settings (transitions, buttons, notify, diurnal, rate_limit) can remain in YAML.
